instances.title: Fix GenAI vector store loading from JAR
instances.problem_statement:
Fix GenAI vector store loading from JAR

## Description

The GenAI service could not load the pre-embedded vector store when running from the Spring Boot executable JAR because `ClassPathResource#getFile()` cannot resolve a nested `BOOT-INF/classes` resource to a filesystem file. Load the `Resource` directly so `SimpleVectorStore` reads its input stream.

N/A
